name: Andre Montgomery Whitaker Fairbanks
extra_bullets: Created the renewal playbook the team now uses for every account, with call scripts, timelines and a checklist for pricing changes
Organized two customer webinars on ticketing reports that more than 300 event managers signed up for
Trained four new delivery drivers on the route software and the returns process
cover_letter_paragraph: I also believe good customer success work is mostly listening. I keep notes on every call, share patterns with product and support each month, and follow up on promises within a day. Customers notice that, and it's often the reason they stay through a difficult year.
